answers.text: Have it return the same three-line shape every time — time, pallet count, then damage.
Ask for one line per call — time, customer, topic, outcome — with follow-ups marked.
Something in the timing here doesn't add up.
The on-time figure holds up — 9 late against 118 gives the 92% they state — but the increase they've quoted elsewhere doesn't feel solid to me, I'd want that checked separately.
I'd sign off Output 2 — it shows its working.
I'd send Email 2 — it's got the actual volume numbers and the PO reference in it. There's nothing behind Email 1's claim that a better rate is deserved.
